Jordan — great to hear the launch is driving the capacity ask. High-level answers below; attaching a proposed order form and a draft SLA/throughput sheet for review.

- Activation model: we recommend a staged activation (2 phases) to validate load and warm cache; phase 1 adds 4 GPUs for initial ramp, phase 2 brings the rest online within 7–14 days. This minimizes cold-cache latency spikes.
- Latency guarantee: we can commit to a 95th-pct tail latency target for the agreed workload profile in the SLA workbook. If traffic patterns deviate we have an overage/fallback policy (described in the XLSX).
- Billing: proration for partial-month activation is itemized on the order form; we'll align invoice dates with your billing cycle if needed.

Next steps: 1) Review the attached order form (OliveAI_OrderForm_v2.pdf), 2) if agreeable, sign via DocuSign link I’ll send, 3) schedule a 30–45 minute ops kickoff with Neha (CS lead) to lock the activation windows.
